name: metal-button
title: Metal Button
description: A pair of pill buttons, one near-white and one dark, each ringed by an animated metallic edge and a faint glow. The shader drifts around the rim while the label, size and fill behave like normal buttons.
use: A hero call to action should feel physical and premium without changing the button's layout.
avoid: The page must stay lightweight or calm: it pulls a shader dependency and the ring never stops.
a11y: The continuously moving ring and glow ignore prefers-reduced-motion, though the button works fine from the keyboard. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded pill buttons sit side by side on black: a near-white Get Started with dark text and a dark Learn More with light text. Each has a thin metallic rim and a soft halo, and the light one carries a silver gradient across its face.
behaves: A shader ring travels around each button's edge and its glow slowly breathes; the labels and fills stay in place. Hovering brightens the button surface through its normal colour transition.
customise: preset, theme, strength, paused, borderRadius, disableGlow and metalVariant tune the shader; variant, size and className style the button. Labels are children.
weight: moderate: A small fragment shader animates continuously behind two buttons.
demo: Buttons labelled Get Started and Learn More.
issues: The metal ring is subtle; in the frames the two buttons look almost plain.
The shader runs continuously and never pauses for reduced motion.
polishWhy: Convincing metallic sheen on clean pill buttons; the effect is subtle and the demo very sparse.
